# A web shop and its own pages

Made-up shop ("Cedar Hollow"), modelled on the cross-page contradictions seen on dropshipping shops: the product page
says "family business in Ohio", "Proudly made in the USA", "30-day free returns" and "ships from our US warehouse";
its returns page gives 14 days at the buyer's cost and a return address in Shenzhen, its shipping page 10-25 business
days. No real shop's names, addresses or text.

- `product.html`: the product page (Shopify-like), linking to about, contact, refund, shipping and terms pages, an
  outside help page and a PDF.
- `returns.html`, `shipping.html`, `about.html`: the shop's own pages.
